Sample.evidence_source: The invariance test was performed by multigroup analysis using the Chi square difference (Δχ2) between the model with free factorial weights and the model with equal weights fitted to sample. To assess the invariance in sexes, the total sample were divided into two subgroups (women: n = 152, men: n = 136) and the test was performed considering analysis of factorial weights (λ), intercepts (I), and residues' variance/covariance (cov/res). The total sample is 152 (women) + 136 (men) = 288.
